bullets.text: The Adambakkam MRTS railway station remains non-functional months after completion, causing severe disappointment to commuters, and the office should monitor its opening.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi appreciated VIT Chennai-incubated MEDxAI Innovations for healthcare AI technology, and the office should monitor institutional AI developments.
